mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 10% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 10% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth is strong but UNRATE remains high, it indicates labor market inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS grows and UNRATE is high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS indicates tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises above 4% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High CPIAUCSL indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL is high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO below 95 indicates supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO falls below 95 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing RSAFS and HOUST signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both RSAFS and HOUST increase but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS in an easing cycle stimulates equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is low but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
